# 📊 Plot 7: Species Richness across all ‘Ōhi‘a samples from O‘ahu, grouped by elevation and ridge

```{r}
#species richness on Oahu across elevations

sr_hight <- 
  meta_data %>%
  filter(island == "Oahu") |>
  filter(commonname == "ʻōhiʻa Lehua") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = elevation, y = richness, color = sample_site, shape = elevation)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Species Richness across all ‘Ōhi‘a samples from O‘ahu\nGrouped by elevation",
       x = "Elevation", 
       y = "Species Richness") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

sr_hight_site_reg <- 
  meta_data %>%
  filter(island == "Oahu") |>
  filter(commonname == "ʻōhiʻa Lehua") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(elevation, levels =
                             c("low", "mid", "high")), y = richness, color = sample_site, shape = elevation, group = sample_site)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Species Richness across all ‘Ōhi‘a samples from O‘ahu\nGrouped by elevation",
       x = "Elevation", 
       y = "Species Richness") +
  facet_wrap(~sample_site) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

sr_hight <- 
  meta_data %>%
  filter(island == "Oahu") |>
  filter(commonname == "ʻōhiʻa Lehua") |>
  filter(sample_id != "KT1") |> 
  filter(sample_id != "KA5") |>
  filter(!str_detect(shortname, "control")) |> 
  drop_na(elevation) |>
  mutate(elev_arrow = case_when(
    elevation == "high" ~ "\u25B2",  # ▲
    elevation == "mid"  ~ "\u25A0",  # ■
    elevation == "low"  ~ "\u25BC"   # ▼
  )) |> 
  mutate(elevation_m = as.numeric(elevation_ft)/3.28) 

sr_hight |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_text(aes(x = elevation_m, y = richness, 
             color = sample_site, label = elev_arrow)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = elevation_m, y = richness,
                  color = sample_site), method = "lm", se = F) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = elevation_m, y = richness), method = "lm", se = T) +
  scale_color_npg() +
  scale_fill_npg() +
  labs(title = "Species Richness across all ‘Ōhi‘a samples from O‘ahu\nGrouped and colored by Ridge",
       x = "Elevation", 
       y = "Species Richness") +
  theme_classic() 


```

```{r}
mod1 <- lm(richness ~ elevation_m, data = sr_hight)
summary(mod1)

```

```{r}
mod2 <- lm(richness ~ elevation_m + sample_site, data = sr_hight)
summary(mod2)
```

```{r}
mod3 <- lmer(richness ~ elevation_m + (1|sample_site), data = sr_hight)
summary(mod3)
```

Species richness increased significantly with elevation across all Oʻahu ʻōhiʻa samples (linear regression: β = 0.047 species/m, R² = 0.28, p = 0.017). Including ridge as an additional factor in multiple regression and mixed-effects models did not improve model fit, and the elevation effect was robust to site effects (see Tables).
